record_title: A width gap and exact near-minimum classification for finite Gilbreath sequences
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The theorem classifies only the regime |K_S| <= 9; widths 10 and above are not classified. It concerns finite strictly increasing Gilbreath sequences and does not resolve Gilbreath's conjecture for the primes. The closest source is recent, so very recent or incompletely indexed follow-up work remains a residual originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
